title: Glyphcovered Letter
wikitext:
The '''Glyphcovered Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Horde|1|Glyphcovered Letter (quest)|Glyphcovered Letter|race=Goblin|class=mage}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
<name>, news goes around Rustgate Ridge that some big shot prodigy mage blasts their way through the coalpits.

Arcane power is cool and all that, but unrefined abilities won't bring you any gold. And it will make us look like amateurs too in turn. Should you ever desire to hone your magical skills to something more profitable, give me a holler up in Rustgate's Tower. Don't forget to bring some coin, my dear!

Wizette Icewhistle, Mage Trainer.
}}
